title: Dealer and sales team interactions
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on dealership and BMW team interactions, with positive examples praising professionalism, transparency, and supportive sales discussions, while many other fragments are too brief or context-limited to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise dealer and sales teams for professionalism, transparency, responsiveness during resolution, and making customers feel well treated.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention escalation, team references, or broad treatment comments without enough context for a reliable sentiment classification.

limitations: Many undetermined fragments are very short or lack context, which limits precise interpretation.
The topic mixes clearly positive team feedback with vague escalation or dealership references that cannot be summarized more specifically without overreach.
Samples are stratified and limited, so they should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews.
